visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair, wearing a navy blazer over a white t-shirt and a name tag, stands behind a light-colored wooden table against a plain grey-blue wall. He smiles and gestures with his right hand as he speaks directly to the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit bathroom where the man is shaving his face with a black electric shaver. He is wearing a light yellow t-shirt. The bathroom has white tiles and a mirror. (3) The man is shown outdoors riding a black Specialized road bike on an asphalt road lined with trees under a bright, sunny sky. He wears black cycling gear, a helmet, and sunglasses. (4) Back in the indoor setting, the man holds a green tube of aloe vera gel and applies it to the back of his hand, rubbing it in. (5) In the bathroom, he shows a green tube of facial cleanser to the camera, then applies white foam to his face and massages it. He then wipes his face with a dark brown towel. (6) He holds a large green spray bottle and sprays luffa water onto his face and hair, closing his eyes. (7) A high-contrast close-up of an official-looking certificate from ECOCERT COSMOS appears on the screen. (8) The man applies moisturizer from a green jar onto his forehead and cheeks, blending it in with both hands. (9) A close-up shows the man's hair being washed with thick white lather under a running shower head. (10) He applies scalp essence from a brown spray bottle onto his hairline and massages his scalp with his fingertips. (11) A stylized product shot of the brown scalp essence bottle appears against a dark background, with several national flags appearing above it to indicate global patents. (12) Finally, the man stands behind the table again, surrounded by the entire line of Kuan Yuan Lian grooming products. A QR code with text appears in the upper right corner as he concludes his presentation.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged East Asian man, approximately 50 years old, clean-shaven, wearing a navy blazer and white t-shirt, also shown in cycling gear and casual home wear.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features three main locations: a clean, modern bathroom with white tiles; a simple studio set with a light-colored wooden table and a grey-blue wall; and an outdoor scenic road with lush green trees and clear skies.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-energy electronic BGM begins with a clear 4/4 beat. A friendly male voice introduces himself and his upcoming 51st birthday, speaking with clear articulation and high valence. (2) A mechanical whirring sound of an electric shaver is layered over the BGM as the narrator discusses his morning routine. (3) A soft rushing sound of wind and outdoor ambience accompanies the narration about cycling outdoors under the sun. (4) The narrator continues with moderate speed, explaining his dislike for complex skincare steps as the BGM remains a consistent, driving background layer. (5) Bubbling and wet splashing sounds occur as the narrator describes using a facial cleanser. (6) A distinct percussive spray/misting sound is heard twice as luffa water is applied to the face. (7) The BGM continues with bright synthesizers as the man explains the international certifications of the products. (8) Splashing water sounds return, signifying a shower scene, while the narrator discusses hair care for middle-aged men. (9) A short, digital click/spray sound is heard as scalp essence is applied, followed by a lighter, faster narration style detailing the patent benefits. (10) The BGM swells slightly in volume for the conclusion, where the narrator enthusiastically invites viewers to join the group buy, ending with a final energetic phrase.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Daily Routine Demonstration -> Product Features -> Proof/Certification -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Kuan Yuan Lian (廣源良) men's grooming products by leveraging the creator's personal brand as a youthful-looking 50-year-old. It uses a daily routine vlog format to showcase the practicality and efficacy of the products for various lifestyle scenarios like shaving, outdoor sports, and aging-related hair care.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly introduces the brand '廣源良', demonstrates the full range of products, mentions a group buy, and includes a QR code for purchasing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished commercial vlog targeting middle-aged male consumers. The use of multiple locations (studio, bathroom, outdoors) enhances the authenticity of the product application demonstration.
